boxes.question: Is the response written as an open letter on behalf of the National Campus Safety Promotion Association?
Does it address students’ parents, schools, and food safety supervision departments as its audience?
Does it explain why campus food safety matters to teenagers’ health, referring to relevant problems such as spoiled meat, excessive pesticide residues, or inadequate tableware disinfection?
Does it advocate a collaborative, full-chain campus food safety management system?
Does it identify current problems in canteen contracting, food supply, and supervision?
Does it call on parents to participate in food safety supervision?
Does it urge schools to implement principal responsibility and open tendering for canteen contracting, and regulatory departments to publish supplier lists and conduct frequent inspections?
Is the letter formal, authoritative, and constructive in tone?
